description: Scenarios for the view-model of the interface, one event per line: `<ms> <EVENT> <arguments>`. Events: TICK, HB <zone level 0-5> (a valid heartbeat of the Jetson), SPI_ERR, SPI_OK, CAN <bus off 0/1> <tx errors> <rx errors>, ESTOP <latched 0/1> (the brain reports the stop latch), MOTION <0/1>, NAV <screen>, DOWN <action> and UP <action> (a touch). `cfg` overrides values of config/ui.cfg for the scenario. tools/ui_model.py replays them; tests/test_ui_core.py replays the same text in the C twin and compares line by line. Evidence: simulator.

scenarios.name: boot_without_jetson_goes_degraded
scenarios.note: No heartbeat ever: starting during the grace, then degraded; STOP works in both, the jog is refused.

scenarios.name: normal_session
scenarios.note: Heartbeats every 100 ms, the jog is armed and used, the screens change, STOP stops and the stop is released with a long press.

scenarios.name: jetson_hangs_then_recovers
scenarios.note: The Jetson stops answering with the machine armed: degraded after the timeout, the jog is disarmed, nothing moves, STOP works; the heartbeat returns and the machine is normal again.

scenarios.name: spi_link_is_cut
scenarios.note: Transactions fail one after another with no heartbeat: first the Jetson is not answering, then, after five failures, the cause shown is the link; a good transaction and a heartbeat bring it back.

scenarios.name: can_errors_rise_to_bus_off
scenarios.note: The error counters climb past the warning level, the bus goes off (commands refused, alarm of fault level), STOP is still sent and, with no confirmation, the panel says so; the bus comes back.

scenarios.name: stop_while_moving
scenarios.note: STOP during a jog: the panel is stopped at once, the stop is confirmed by the brain, but the axis is still reported moving a second later: an alarm of fault level until it stops.

scenarios.name: stop_is_never_confirmed
scenarios.note: STOP is touched and the brain never reports the latch: after the confirmation time the banner says not to rely on it; a later report clears it.

scenarios.name: listen_only_refuses_everything_but_stop
scenarios.note: Listen-only on: the jog and the release are refused with their reason, STOP still goes out; leaving it needs a long press and a short touch does nothing.

scenarios.name: release_needs_a_long_press
scenarios.note: A short touch on release does nothing; the full hold sends the release request once.

scenarios.name: degraded_release_refused_by_default
scenarios.note: Stopped and the Jetson is gone: the panel does not release the stop on its own authority.

scenarios.name: degraded_release_switch_on
scenarios.note: With degraded_allow_release on, the same hold releases the stop with the Jetson gone; motion is still refused.

scenarios.name: degraded_motion_switch_on
scenarios.note: With degraded_allow_motion on the jog works with the Jetson gone, and the safety verdict reads unknown.

scenarios.name: zone_verdicts_of_the_jetson
scenarios.note: The levels of the safety service become alarms; danger and inhibited stop the machine from moving, an acknowledge silences without clearing, and the stop cannot be released while a danger holds.

scenarios.name: jog_arming_expires
scenarios.note: The armed jog lasts ten seconds and then the jog is refused again.

scenarios.name: worst_case_everything_fails
scenarios.note: Jetson silent, bus off and a stop pending at once: the panel still sends STOP and shows the stop banner that says not to rely on it.

scenarios.name: settings_and_navigation
scenarios.note: Navigation and the language never depend on the state; hostile values (an unknown action, a level out of range, a screen out of range, time going back) change nothing they should not.
